events.title: After one season at 에버턴 , 게리 리네커 departs to 바르셀로나 of Spain in a £2.75 million deal, where he will play alongside former 맨체스터 유나이티드 striker Mark Hughes in a side managed by Terry Venables . Ian Rush agrees a £3.2 million transfer to 유벤투스 of Italy in a record fee for a British player, but will remain at 리버풀 on loan for a season.
레인저스 sign 노리치 시티 goalkeeper Chris Woods for £600,000.
코번트리 시티 sign striker Keith Houchen from 스컨소프 유나이티드 for £60,000.

Two big First Division clubs buy young players from smaller clubs as they prepare to build for the future. 에버턴 sign 20-year-old winger Neil Adams from 스토크 시티 for £150,000, while 토트넘 홋스퍼 sign 21-year-old defender Mitchell Thomas from 루턴 타운 for £233,000.
Sir Stanley Rous , chairman of The Football Association from 1934 to 1961, dies aged 91.

입스위치 타운 , relegated to the Second Division at the end of last season, sell England international defender Terry Butcher to 레인저스, managed by former 리버풀 midfielder Graeme Souness , in a £700,000 deal – a record for a Scottish club.

미들즈브러 are wound up in the High Court due to debts in excess of £1million, but have yet to be expelled from the Football League and may yet be included in the first round draw for the Football League Cup .

울버햄프턴 원더러스 win a High Court appeal against their winding-up order, enabling them to compete in the Fourth Division campaign – the first time they have played at this level. Meanwhile, 미들즈브러 are also reprieved, but the bailiffs have locked them out of Ayresome Park and they are expected to play at least one home game at 하틀리풀 유나이티드 's ground.
리버풀 pay £200,000 for 선덜랜드 defender Barry Venison .
